A junction of old routes, Forsaken enough that it's clearly seen more use than the maps suggest.

GM Notes

Encounter: This room refills with a new threat if left and returned to later, on the same table used for the floor's other random encounters.

Hazard: A residual effect lingers in the air, growing worse the longer anyone stays without taking precautions (DC 15 to resist each round).
